title: acorn: change parseIdent(liberal) to an options object at all call sites
prompt: This is a copy of the acorn JavaScript parser (acorn/src). `Parser.prototype.parseIdent` currently takes a positional boolean `liberal`, and call sites pass `true`, `false` or an expression such as `this.options.allowReserved !== "never"`, which is unreadable. Change its signature to take an optional options object, `parseIdent({ liberal })` (no argument means `liberal: false`), and update every caller in the source so that no call passes a bare boolean any more. Behaviour (ASTs, errors, the allowReserved: "never" handling) must be identical.
